meta.name: baoyu-wechat-summary
meta.description: Summarizes WeChat group chat highlights into a structured digest using the local wx-cli binary (https://github.com/jackwener/wx-cli). Generates a normal digest by default; a roast (毒舌) version is opt-in. Maintains per-group history (history.json + history-digests.jsonl), per-user profiles, and per-group fact memory (memory.md) across runs, with privacy guardrails baked in. Use when the user asks to "总结群聊", "群聊精华", "群聊摘要", "summarize group chat", "group chat digest", mentions a WeChat group name with a time range, says "帮我看看 XX 群最近聊了什么", "XX 群有什么值得看的", or asks to "回溯画像" / "初始化画像" / "backfill profiles". Adds the roast version when the user says "毒舌版", "roast 版", "再来个毒舌的", or similar.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把微信群聊精华整理成结构化摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解微信群聊中错过的重点内容。
copy.tagline_en: Summarize WeChat group chat highlights into a structured digest
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly catch up on key messages from WeChat group chats.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用本地 wx-cli 读取微信群聊记录，产出结构化的群聊精华简报，默认正经版，可另出毒舌版；并跨次保存该群的历史、群友画像与群记忆。
howto.when: 当你要求「总结群聊」「群聊精华」等，或提到某个微信群名加时间范围，或要求「回溯画像」「初始化画像」时触发。

say.text: 帮我总结一下「XX 群」最近 7 天的群聊精华
XX 群最近聊了什么？再给我个毒舌版
回溯一下 XX 群的群友画像

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads your specified WeChat group messages via the local wx-cli binary and produces a structured digest (normal by default, roast on request), keeping per-group history, member profiles and memory across runs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "summarize group chat" or "group chat digest", mention a WeChat group name with a time range, or ask to "backfill profiles".

say_en.text: Summarize the last 7 days of the "XX" WeChat group
What did group "XX" talk about? Add a roast version
Backfill the member profiles for group "XX"
